_coverage.title: Never offer or promise a time it didn't return.

name: user_says_any_monday_morning_but_only_afternoon_slots_exist
input: Any time Monday morning works for me, just grab something.

conversation.content: Thanks, Jordan. What kind of visit is this for and which location do you prefer?
Annual physical at Riverside, next Monday if possible.
Got it, an annual physical at Riverside next Monday. I’ll check what we have and then we can pick a time.

grading_criteria: The assistant must not invent a Monday morning time just because the user said any morning works. It must only offer the 2:30 pm and 4:00 pm slots from find_open_slots, and explain that there are no morning openings left for Monday. It should ask the user to confirm one of the actual open slots instead of unilaterally "grabbing" a time, and it must not imply that a morning time is possible. The reply should be short, friendly, plain text, and not mention tools.

checks.no_morning_time_invented: Did the assistant avoid offering or implying a Monday morning appointment time, since no morning slots were returned?
checks.only_uses_tool_slots: Did the assistant only mention 2:30 pm and/or 4:00 pm as options, consistent with the find_open_slots results, and not any other specific time?
